title: Signed Inbound Workorders
description: Update `workorder.schema.json` to require a detached issuer signature block on inbound envelopes. The WDD engine must reject unsigned envelopes.

requirements.signature: Add `issuer_signature` object to the schema containing `alg`, `key_id`, and `signature_hex`.

acceptance_criteria: The schema validates an envelope with a valid signature block.
failure_modes: FAIL: Forgetting to make the signature block required in enforcing mode.
